name: GOV base: OwnershipTransferred
description: OpenZeppelin Ownable (v4/v5), EIP-173: OwnershipTransferred(address,address) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity critical. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the new holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
